name: Infernal Magic

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You have a few pieces of devilish magic at your disposal. You can cast Divine Lance as a divine innate spell at will, heightened to half your level rounded up. Additionally, you can cast 1st-rank Fear and 2nd-rank Spiritual Armament as divine innate spells once per day each. You also gain the Invoke Infernal Potency action.
